messages:
Diego Morales: Heads-up: external assessment scheduled next month. Need to finalize readroom access pattern, RBAC deltas, and post-engagement retest window. Thinking 24h retest window with 3 x 2h slots to keep ops load light. Thoughts?
Priya Patel: 24h window sounds sane. I'll own RBAC templates. Plan: issue OIDC-based short-lived sessions (max 3h), restrict to: sts:AssumeRole + Condition StringEquals oidc:sub:assessor/<id>. Example policy snippet I'll paste in the ticket.
Priya Patel: ```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": "sts:AssumeRole",
      "Resource": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/pen-test-readroom",
      "Condition": {
        "StringEquals": {"oidc:sub": "assessor/bluequall"},
        "Bool": {"aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent": "true"}
      }
    }
  ]
}
```
Jules Park: For logging: we should enable CloudTrail multi-region + Athena export and keep raw exports for 180 days for pen tests (longer than normal). Also enable S3 versioning + MFA delete on the evidence bucket. Ops, can you wire a daily checksum job that writes a manifest.sha256 to the audit bucket?
ops-runner: Yes. We can run a lambda that computes SHA256 of each uploaded object and append to manifest. Presigned upload TTL = 8h by default for assessors. We'll enable S3 Object Lock in GOVERNANCE mode for the evidence bucket and lifecycle rule to expire after 365 days (per policy).
Diego Morales: Good. KMS question: do we allow assessors to request plain data keys or only wrapped keys? My vote: only wrapped keys via dedicated encryption key that we rotate immediately after the window.
ops-runner: Agreed. We'll expose a /v1/wrap endpoint on the kms-gateway that returns EncryptedBlob (wrapped key) and metadata. Example request (ops-run):
```bash
curl -X POST https://kms-gateway.internal/v1/wrap -H "Authorization: Bearer $READROOM_TOKEN" -d '{"purpose":"readroom-upload","ttl":"3h"}'
```
Response will include kms_blob, key_id, and expires_at. We will not give raw plaintext keys.
audit-bot: Reminder: compliance requires chain-of-custody logs for every key unwrap/wrap call and the assessor's session id recorded in CloudTrail. Also need assessor email in intake form.
Priya Patel: I'll add session-tagging middleware so every assume-role and STS token has tag:assessor_email.
Diego Morales: Ops, can we get an automated playbook that: (1) creates read-only bucket + object lock, (2) provisions OIDC-assume role, (3) starts kms-gateway with timeboxed token, (4) runs checksum lambda, (5) rotates KMS key after window? If so, I can sign off.
ops-runner: Yes, we can script that as a runbook. I estimate PR + runbook by Tue EOD. Will also add a healthcheck that verifies CloudTrail exports completed and manifest contains >=1 file before readroom opens.
Jules Park: One extra: include a small incident response corridor in the readroom runbook in case someone finds high-severity auth bypass during testing. Quick rollback steps + contact list.
Diego Morales: Perfect. Action items: Priya = RBAC PR + tagging middleware; ops-runner = runbook + presigned bucket + checksums; Jules = logging retention & incident corridor doc; Diego = update intake with assessor contact and publish retest slots. We'll reconvene once PRs are green. :white_check_mark:
